y-m-83-07.title: Umbiko othi umthetho onamathuba ambalwa kakhulu ophephe kakhulu
y-m-83-07.goal: Thola iphutha embikweni lapho ukubala kulungile kodwa isiphetho siphosile, klama imithetho ehlangabezana nezimo wena, bese uhlulela umcabango odingekayo ukukhuluma ngamathuba usebenzisa inani lamathuba.
y-m-83-07.material: Sifuna ukunquma umthetho wenombolo yokukhiya yesikhiyi seklabhu. Inombolo inamadijithi angu-4, futhi indawo ngayinye isebenzisa elinye lamadijithi angu-0 kuya ku-9. Umthetho R1 uvumela idijithi elifanayo ukuba lisetshenziswe izikhathi eziningi, u-R2 udinga wonke amadijithi amane ahlukile, futhi u-R3 uvumela idijithi elifanayo ukuba lisetshenziswe kodwa idijithi lokuqala akumele libe ngu-0. Umfundi wabhala ingxenye yombiko oqhathanisa imithetho ngokubala izinombolo ezingenzeka ngaphansi komthetho ngamunye. Indlela inombolo ekhethwa ngayo ayikanqunywa.
y-m-83-07.thinking.0: Ukubona ukuthi isiphetho singaphosa noma ukubala kulungile
y-m-83-07.prereq.0: Ukucabanga ngohlelo lwesikole: lokhu kubonwa njengomsebenzi wocwaningo osetshenziswa ngemuva kokufunda ukubala (umthetho womkhiqizo, ama-permutation) nemiqondo eyisisekelo yamathuba. U-'H3' ulebula nje yezinga lobunzima le-batch yokukhiqiza, hhayi ukwabiwa kwebanga.
y-m-83-07.prereq.2: Umqondo wokuthi uma amacala angenzeka enamathuba alinganayo, ithuba lingu-1/(inani lamacala)
y-m-83-07.s.s1.prompt: Lona umbiko oqhathanisa imithetho yenombolo yokukhiya yesikhiyi seklabhu (amadijithi angu-4) ngenani lamathuba. Khetha umugqa owodwa lapho ukucabanga kungafaneli. (Izinombolo zemigqa zibonisiwe kusukela ku-1 esikrinini.)
y-m-83-07.s.s1.hint.0: Kumthetho ngamunye, sho ngamagama ukuthi zingaki izinombolo ongakhetha kuzo uma ukhetha inombolo eyodwa futhi uzama ukuyiqagela.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.hint.1: Qhathanisa ukuthi ithuba lokuqagela lihluka kanjani uma ukhetha noma iyiphi inombolo uma kunamathuba angu-5040 uma kuqhathaniswa nangu-10000.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.0: Umthetho R1 (idijithi elifanayo lingasetshenziswa izikhathi eziningi): indawo ngayinye ingasebenzisa noma yiliphi lika-0 kuya ku-9, ngakho kunamathuba angu-10×10×10×10 = 10000.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.1: Umthetho R2 (wonke amadijithi amane ahlukile): angu-10 okokuqala, angu-9 okwesibili, angu-8 okwesithathu, angu-7 okwesine, ngakho 10×9×8×7 = 5040 amathuba.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.2: Umthetho R3 (idijithi elifanayo livunyelwe kodwa indawo yokuqala akusilo u-0): angu-9 okokuqala nangu-10 kunye nokusele, ngakho 9×10×10×10 = 9000 amathuba.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.3: Ngakho inani lamathuba ngu-R2 < R3 < R1. U-R2, onamathuba ambalwa kakhulu, ophephe kakhulu.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.line.4: Ngakho ukusebenzisa umthetho ongavumeli amadijithi aphindwayo kwenza inombolo iphephe kakhulu.
y-m-83-07.s.s1.explain: Ukubala kwamathuba emigqeni 1 kuya ku-3 (10000, 5040, 9000) kulungile. Kodwa umugqa 4 wathi umthetho onamathuba ambalwa kakhulu ophephe kakhulu. Lapho omunye umuntu ezama ukuqagela inombolo ngokukhetha, uma izinombolo ezingenzeka ziningi, kunzima ukuyiqagela. Umugqa 5 uyisiphetho esivela ephutheni elifanayo.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.prompt: Kulokhu, klama umthetho wokukhiya wena. Inani lamakhodi angenzeka kumele libe ngu-1,000,000 noma ngaphezulu, futhi ukwenza kube lula ukukhumbula, ubude buba ngu-5 noma ngaphansi. Inani lezinhlobo zezinhlamvu ongazisebenzisa, u-k, linye lika-10 (amadijithi kuphela), 26 (izinhlamvu ezincane zesiNgisi kuphela), 36 (amadijithi + izinhlamvu ezincane zesiNgisi), noma 62 (amadijithi + izinhlamvu zesiNgisi ezincane nezinkulu), futhi uhlamvu olufanayo lungasetshenziswa izikhathi eziningi. Thola u-(k, n) abangu-3 abahlukile abahlangabezana nezimo.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.hint.0: Khetha u-k no-n eyodwa ngesikhathi bese ubala ukuthi kunamakhodi amangaki angenzeka. Hlola ukuthi ku-k ethile ngisho no-n olingana no-5 akwanele yini.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.hint.1: Setha u-n abe ngu-4 no-5 bese uqhathanisa ukuthi u-k kumele abe mkhulu kangakanani ukudlula isimo.

y-m-83-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Ubude u-n kumele bube yinombolo yemvelo kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-5.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Inani lamakhodi angenzeka (u-k uphindaphindwe izikhathi ezingu-n) lingaphansi kuka-1,000,000.
y-m-83-07.s.s2.explain: Amacala anu-k^n≥1,000,000 ngu-(26, 5)=11,881,376, u-(36, 4)=1,679,616, u-(36, 5), u-(62, 4), u-(62, 5). Ngamadijithi kuphela (k=10), u-n=5 unika kuphela amathuba angu-100,000, ngakho ubude obungu-6 bubuzodingeka, futhi izinhlamvu ezincane zesiNgisi ezingu-4 (26⁴=456,976) nazo azanele.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.prompt: Ufuna ukusho ukuthi 'ngaphansi komthetho R1, ithuba lokuqagela inombolo ngokukhetha okukodwa ngu-1/10000.' Ukuze lesi sitatimende sisebenze, yimuphi umcabango odingekayo kulokhu okulandelayo?
y-m-83-07.s.s3.hint.0: Cabanga empilweni yangempela ukuthi zonke izinombolo ezingu-10000 ezingenzeka zizosetshenziswa isikhathi esifanayo yini.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.hint.1: Thola lapho umcabango we-'enamathuba alinganayo' usetshenziswa khona ekubaleni okunika ithuba elingu-1/10000.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.a: Inombolo kumele ibe lula ukukhumbula, njenge-1234, futhi akumele iphindwe.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.a: Izinombolo ezilula ukuzikhumbula yizona ngempela abantu abazama kuqala. Kungenza kube lula ukuyiqagela.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.b: Umuntu ozama ukuqagela kumele sekuvele azame kanye noma kabili wehluleka.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.b: Ukuthi ubezamile ngaphambili akusilo ithuba lomzamo wokuqala. Sebenza ukuthi ithuba elingu-1/10000 liyithuba lani.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.c: Izinombolo ezingu-10000 zikhethwa ngamathuba alinganayo, futhi umuntu oqagelayo uyawazi umthetho.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.c: Uyazi ukuthi ukuze ithuba libe 'ukuphindaphindeka kwenani lamathuba,' umcabango udingeka wokuthi amacala angenzeka enamathuba alinganayo.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.o.d: Umthetho kumele uguqulwe ube ngonjenge-R2 ongavumeli amadijithi aphindwayo.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.r.d: Lesi simo asinakho ukuhlobana nokuthi umthetho R1 uyini. Uma uguqula u-R1 ube ngu-R2, inani lamathuba uqobo liyashintsha.
y-m-83-07.s.s3.explain: Ukuze ukuphindaphindeka kwenani lamathuba kube yithuba, udinga umcabango wokuthi izinombolo ezingenzeka zikhethwa ngamathuba alinganayo. Uma abantu bevame ukukhetha izinsuku zokuzalwa noma u-1234, ithuba langempela lokuqagela lingaba likhulu kunalokhu. Inani lamathuba linye kuphela lesisekelo sokuphepha.

y-m-83-02.title: Amaphoyinti angu-100 angahlukanisa u-3.12 no-3.14?
y-m-83-02.goal: Embikweni olinganisele i-π ngokubeka amaphoyinti ngokungahleliwe, thola lapho wenza izimangalo ngokuqinile kakhulu, usho imikhawulo yesiphetho ngokususelwa ekutheni imiphumela ephindiwe isabalele kanjani, futhi wenze wena ukuhlola okuthembeke kakhulu.
y-m-83-02.material: Sifuna ukulinganisela inani le-pi (π) ngesimulation. Ohlelweni lokuxhumanisa, ikhompyutha ibeka amaphoyinti ngokufanayo ngokungahleliwe ngaphakathi kwesikwele esine-0 ≤ x ≤ 1 no-0 ≤ y ≤ 1 (ubude bohlangothi 1). Uma x² + y² < 1 (x isikwele nesikwele sika-y kuncane kuno-1), iphoyinti liphakathi kwekota yesiyingi esinobubanzi obungu-1. Indawo yekota yesiyingi ngu-π/4 futhi indawo yesikwele ngu-1, ngakho ithuba lokuthi iphoyinti lehlele ngaphakathi kwekota yesiyingi ngu-π/4. Iqembu elilodwa labeka amaphoyinti angu-100 futhi labhala umbiko.
y-m-83-02.thinking.1: Ukuqhathanisa ukuthi imiphumela ephindiwe isabalele kanjani
y-m-83-02.prereq.0: Umbono wokulandelana kwesikole: lokhu kubonwa njengomsebenzi wocwaningo osetshenziswe ngemva kokufunda iyunithi yamathuba (amathuba atholwa ngendawo, ukuphindaphinda izivivinyo). I-'H3' iwuphawu lizinga lobunzima kuphela lale batch yokukhiqiza, hhayi isabelo sebanga.
y-m-83-02.prereq.1: Ifomula yendawo yesiyingi nencazelo yekota yesiyingi
y-m-83-02.prereq.2: Umqondo wokuthi ithuba lingumlinganiselo wezindawo (ifomula ye-standard deviation ayidingeki)
y-m-83-02.s.s1.prompt: Lena ingxenye yombiko obhalwe yiqembu elilodwa. Khetha umugqa owodwa lapho ubufakazi bungenele enqubweni yokufinyelela esiphethweni. (Izinombolo zemigqa zibonisiwe kusuka ku-1 esikrinini.)
y-m-83-02.s.s1.hint.0: Hlela umugqa ngamunye ku-'lokho okubonwe,' 'lokho okubaliwe,' noma 'lokho okunqunyiwe njengesiphetho.'
y-m-83-02.s.s1.hint.1: Uma wenza ukuhlola okufanayo futhi kanye, cabanga ukuthi u-78 wawuzophuma futhi ngqo yini.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.0: Amaphoyinti angu-100 abekwe ngokungahleliwe ngaphakathi kwesikwele.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.1: Phakathi kwawo, amaphoyinti anoku-x² + y² < 1, okungukuthi, amaphoyinti angaphakathi kwekota yesiyingi, ayengu-78.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.2: Ithuba lokuthi iphoyinti lehlele ngaphakathi kwekota yesiyingi ngumlinganiselo wendawo π/4, ngakho singasho ukuthi 78/100 ≈ π/4.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.4: Ngakho π ngu-3.12, futhi lokhu kuncane kuno-3.14.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.line.5: Uma sikhulisa amaphoyinti afike ku-1000, umphumela uzoba seduze no-3.14 ngokuqinisekile.
y-m-83-02.s.s1.explain: Umugqa we-5 umemezele isilinganiso esingu-3.12 esivela kumaphoyinti angu-100 njengaleli lingenani le-π, futhi umugqa we-6 umemezele ukuthi ukwengeza amaphoyinti 'ngokuqinisekile' kuzosondela. Ukuhlola okungahleliwe kunika umphumela ohlukile noma ukwenza ngendlela efanayo futhi, futhi ngamaphoyinti amaningi ukusabalala kuthambekela ekuncipheni, kodwa ayikho isiqinisekiso sokuthi umphumela owodwa usondele. Izinyathelo emigqeni 1 kuya ku-4 (umlinganiselo → π/4 → izikhathi ezi-4) zingasetshenziswa njengoba zinjalo.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.prompt: Amaqembu amahlanu ngalinye labeka amaphoyinti angu-100 ngendlela efanayo futhi abala amaphoyinti angaphakathi kwekota yesiyingi, athola u-78, 81, 74, 80, no-77. Izilinganiso 4×(inani lamaphoyinti)/100 ziyi-3.12, 3.24, 2.96, 3.20, 3.08, futhi isilinganiso singu-3.12. Ubukhona kanjani isitatimende esithi 'lokhu kuhlola kusitshela ukuthi π incane kuno-3.14'?
y-m-83-02.s.s2.hint.0: Thola umehluko phakathi kokuncane nokukhulu kwezilinganiso ezinhlanu.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.hint.1: Beka loyo mehluko eduze komehluko phakathi kuka-3.14 no-3.12 futhi uqhathanise.
y-m-83-02.s.s2.o.a: U-3.12 yinani elisondele kakhulu ku-3.14, ngakho iqembu elathola leli nani lenze ukuhlola ngokunembe kakhulu.

y-m-83-02.s.s2.o.b: Isilinganiso semiphumela emihlanu singu-3.12, ngakho singanquma ukuthi π ngu-3.12 futhi incane kuno-3.14.

y-m-83-02.s.s2.r.c: Uqhathanise ukusabalala kwemiphumela ephindiwe (0.28) nomehluko ofuna ukuwazi (0.02), futhi wabona ukuthi ukusabalala kukhulu kakhulu.

y-m-83-02.s.s2.r.d: Ufunde imiphumela ehlukile njengokusho ukuthi ukuhlola akusizi. Uma wazi ukuthi ukusabalala kubanzi kangakanani, usengasho ukuthi π ingu-3 cishe.

Ngakho lokhu kuhlola akukwazi ukusho ukuthi yiluphi olulungile phakathi kuka-3.12 no-3.14, futhi kungasho kuphela ukuthi π ingu-3 cishe.
